evidence_snippets: 17th January 1995, 5:46: an earthquake of Magnitude 7.9 shook the city of Kobe and adjoining areas in Hyogo prefectures.
It took more than 6,400 lives, destroyed thousands of houses and left millions of people homeless.
The Great Hanshin-Awaji Earthquake of Kobe (Hyogo) in Japan.
